about: Every 'chain checks' clause of every story in M1-STORIES.md, reconciled with the Lean. class: guard (a constructor hypothesis or definition, file:line, with the token the line must contain), omission (the Lean does not model it; the simulator says so), overrule (the Lean decides differently; the simulator follows the Lean). The scenario gate extracts the clauses from M1-STORIES.md and fails when one is missing here, when a guard anchor does not contain its token, or when a distinctive clause has no exercising scenario step.

distinctive.clause: registration brings D and B and a first pool
a keep rotation with the pool covering P pays P to the payee
a keep rotation with a short pool lands unpaid: payment is never a gate
a freeze pays B to the hunter and leaves the datum
a keep rotation from a frozen state lands and stays frozen
a withdraw rotation from a frozen state pays what is held and parks
a depositing rotation from a frozen state restores both bonds and restarts juvenility
a withdraw rotation from a live state pays D + B + pool to the refund address
the current-epoch quorum can poison a paused checkpoint (accepted; gains nothing)
the current-epoch quorum can close a paused checkpoint: zero paid, token burned
keys of a retired epoch cannot close or poison a paused checkpoint
a paused checkpoint cannot be frozen: no freeze bond to take

close is disabled while poisoned

the poison is declared once per epoch

a rotation whose new keys signed the address moves it
